attributes.summary:
Mayo Clinic's Hospital Medicine for NPs & PAs runs February 17 to 20, 2027, at the Laguna Cliffs Resort & Spa in Dana Point, California. The course reviews current guidelines and treatment pathways for hospitalized patients, with objectives on ethical dilemmas, angina evaluation, renal disease in the hospital and thrombocytopenia. It is aimed at NPs, PAs, hospitalists, nurses and residents.

The in-person course is designated for 18.5 AMA PRA Category 1 Credits, 18.5 AAPA Category 1 CME credits and 18.5 ANCC contact hours, and costs $799. Attendees can submit poster abstracts until January 4, 2027. The hotel block cutoff is January 26, 2027, or earlier if the block sells out.
